history.plain_line: TaskMarket's unpaid share of decided reward over 30 days rose from 7.3% to 17.9%, because one 25 USDC task reached its grace end with no submissions, so no one could be paid; the unpaid share of submissions, which the grade uses, fell from 0.90% to 0.49% as 4 old tasks left the 30-day window (18 October).

history.name: TaskMarket
